Allaah said: ?O Adam, how do you know Muhammad when I have not created him yet?? He said: ?O Lord, because when You created me with Your hand and breathed into me the soul that Your created for me, I lifted my head and I saw it written on the pillars of the Throne: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah Muhammad Rasool Allaah, and I knew that You would not attach to Your name any but the most beloved of creation to You.? answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 184367 Country: Bangladesh Title: Offering Salah wearing turban Question: If the prayer is performed after the turban, the reward of 70 rakah prayers, is this hadith sahih? Answer ID: 184367 Posted on: Jan 31, 2022 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 700/552/M=6/1443) This has been narrated by Dailami in “Musnad al-Firdaus” (2/265, No. 3233); but this is not established from the Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him). Therefore, Allama Sakhawi (may Allah have mercy upon him) said about this narration in “Al-Maqasid Al-Hasana (p.: 406): لا يثبت(It is not proved as hadith). Mullah Ali Qari (may Allah have mercy upon him) has termed this hadith as maudhu (fabricated). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
